subject: Transportation Systems
title: CBTC: The Digital Upgrade
description: A quick win: understand CBTC: The Digital Upgrade.

hook.text: Communications-Based Train Control replaces physical signals with continuous radio communication.

buildup.text: Each train broadcasts its exact position. A central computer knows where every train is in real time.

discovery.text: CBTC lets trains run much closer together safely, boosting capacity by 20 to 30 percent.

twist.text: Installing CBTC on an old system means running the new and old signals in parallel for years.

climax.text: London, Paris, and New York are all slowly migrating to CBTC—one line at a time.

punchline.text: Digital signals squeeze more trains from the same tunnel.

quiz.question: How does CBTC increase subway capacity?
options: By allowing trains to run safely closer together
